sloka: वैनतेयेन संस्पृष्टास्तयोः संरुरुहुर्व्रणाः ।सुवर्णे च तनू स्निग्धे तयोराशु बभूवतुः ।। ६.५०.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: vainateyena saṁspṛṣṭāstayoḥ saṁruruhurvraṇāḥ ।suvarṇe ca tanū snigdhe tayorāśu babhūvatuḥ ।। 6.50.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Caressed by Garuda, both their bodies were cleared of wounds instantly shone like gold and turned bright.
